avis.titre: A go to in my morning routine
avis.texte: I was looking for a azelaic acid after I started using a retinol a few months back and after reading some reviews and watching a few videos I landed on this one instead of the prescription strength 15% azelaic acid offered by my doctor. I use this product every morning - it is generally the second product in my routine after my facewash and Acure serum and I have been really happy with the results. As a teenager I had bad acne and took Absorica (accu- tane) which has permanently left my skin rosy and sensitive. Redness is my biggest insecurity and I generally wake up with a red face in the morning and after washing my face. Since using this in the morning paired with retinol at night 3 times a week, I have seen a big improvement in my redness as well as my skin texture and the appearance of my pores. I have already repurchased this product twice and will continue to use it going forward. I feel I can go to work without foundation for the first time in years and feel great about the appearance of my skin.

avis.titre: Fantastic! I would buy it again!

I think this probably works wonders for some people, but its not for me. I'll stick with LRP Cicapair spray for a redness reducing serum.

I recently started using the AUNA Azelaic Acid 10% Hyaluron Redness Soothing Serum, and my first impression was that it is lightweight, easy to apply, and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue. I picked this serum to mainly help with my texture bumps and after a few weeks, I noticed smother skin. In my opinion, this serum is gentle yet effective. It features 10% azelaic acid to target texture, combined with hyaluronic acid acid to keep skin hydrated. For me, this combination worked well without causing irritation, which it's important for my combination skin. I would give this serum 4 out of 5 stars. The price is reasonable for the quality of the ingredients, and it offers good value for buyers looking for a daily redness soothing serum. My expectations were met. It smoothed and reduced my texture bumps, even though results took a couple of weeks to appear. Overall, i would repurchase this serum because it fits well into a daily routine and is ideal for anyone looking to reduce mild texture issues or redness. It met my expectations and is a reliable addition to any skincare regimen for sensitive or normal skin types.

avis.titre: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Best choice for my hormonal acne

avis.titre: Be careful if you are sensitive to propylene glycol
avis.texte: This product made my skin break out in a rash overnight. I researched the ingredients and found that the ingredient in propylene glycol can cause this type of reaction. I have used Azelaic Acid for a year by another brand and never had a reaction. I did like the texture and could see how this would be a nice product if you do not have sensitive skin.
